question: Is the obligation to collect and analyze delta-BHC samples at the source water intake contingent on prior EPA/NMED approval of the detailed study plan (i.e., does 'Once approved' mean that no sampling is required until the plan is approved)?
semantic_arguments: The passage first requires plan submission within six months of the permit effective date for EPA/NMED approval
The sampling obligation is introduced with the conditional phrase 'Once approved'
Federal FY2025 is the evaluation window for determining whether monitoring was required
Pre-approval periods may bear on whether required monitoring lacks adequate evidence (Purpose C)
notes: The passage sequences plan submission and approval before imposing quarterly sampling during permit years 2–5. Different readings of whether sampling is strictly contingent on plan approval would change which monitoring obligations are treated as applicable and how missing or absent delta-BHC results are classified.
